headline: A Disciplined Six-Stage Delivery Framework
subtitle: Every engagement—from custom websites and mobile apps to architectural building plans and AI training—follows a transparent six-stage workflow with clear milestones.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: Understanding the client's needs, audience, technical constraints, and business objectives before writing a line of code or drawing a layout.
activities: Stakeholder discovery session and requirements gathering
Audience, workflow, and operational bottleneck analysis
Review of existing brand assets, systems, or site plans

steps.title: Planning
steps.description: Developing the right strategy, scope architecture, technical stack, and milestone roadmap aligned with your timeline.
activities: Information architecture, sitemap, or functional specification
Technology selection and external integration mapping
Milestone schedule and deliverable acceptance criteria

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Creating the visual experience, interface systems, brand assets, or architectural floor plans with clarity and intentional hierarchy.
activities: Wireframes, visual prototypes, or spatial zoning concepts
Typography, color system, and responsive layout design
Structured client review and refinement cycle
steps.deliverable: Approved Visual Design System or CAD Concept

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Building the solution using modern frameworks, clean maintainable architecture, responsive layouts, and reliable integrations.
activities: Frontend, backend, mobile, or print-ready asset production
CMS structure setup and configurable ordering integration
Code quality checks, semantic markup, and SEO implementation

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: Testing across devices, verifying performance and accessibility, and delivering the finished project ready for real-world launch.
activities: Cross-browser, mobile viewport, and accessibility verification

steps.title: Support
steps.description: Providing ongoing technical assistance, team training, and iterative improvements whenever your business needs to evolve.
activities: Post-launch monitoring and minor refinement support
Content management guidance and AI workflow coaching
Planned feature expansions as your business scales

collaborationNoteBody: You never have to guess where a project stands. Each stage concludes with a concrete deliverable for your review before we move forward.

seo.title: Our Process — TOP TECH
seo.description: Explore TOP TECH's six-stage project delivery process: Discovery, Planning, Design, Development, Delivery, and Support.
